up: Retrieve the first 1000 IC50 activity rows that have a non-null pChEMBL value for the human single‑protein target CHEMBL2176774 (Bromodomain‑containing protein 1). The target must have target_type = 'SINGLE PROTEIN' and organism 'Homo sapiens' (tax_id = 9606). For each row, return the following columns: assay ChEMBL ID, target type, target organism tax ID, canonical SMILES of the compound, molecule ChEMBL ID, standard type (which will be 'IC50'), and pChEMBL value. Include only rows where the standard relation is exactly '=' and the pChEMBL value is not null. Order the result set by molecule ChEMBL ID ascending and assay ChEMBL ID ascending. Limit the output to 1000 rows.
sql: SELECT ass.chembl_id AS assay_chembl_id, td.target_type AS target_type, td.tax_id AS tax_id, cs.canonical_smiles AS canonical_smiles, md.chembl_id AS molecule_chembl_id, act.standard_type AS standard_type, act.pchembl_value AS pchembl_value FROM activities act INNER JOIN assays ass ON act.assay_id = ass.assay_id INNER JOIN target_dictionary td ON ass.tid = td.tid INNER JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON act.molregno = md.molregno INNER JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE td.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL2176774' AND td.target_type = 'SINGLE PROTEIN' AND td.tax_id = 9606 AND act.standard_type = 'IC50' AND act.standard_relation = '=' AND act.pchembl_value IS NOT NULL ORDER BY md.chembl_id ASC, ass.chembl_id ASC LIMIT 1000;
